name: Sayam Mukherjee
headline: Computer Science Engineering Student | AI & Machine Learning | Software Development
summary: Computer Science Engineering undergraduate at Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) specializing in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning with a 9.06/10 first-year CGPA. Shipped 6 projects in React, Next.js, Node.js, and Python, including a multi-agent AI platform. Progressed from national finalist (Toycathon 2021, Technex'26) to team leader at DataForge 2026, Ignithon 2.0, and WCC Launchpad 30, with a working command of data structures and algorithms.

projects.subtitle: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Kharagpur
projects.description: Directed the team that created a React 18 learning tool with a 7-stage write/read pipeline inspector, interference heatmaps, and 5 experiments on overwrite collisions, context order, and capacity limits.
